purpose: Prevent SkillScout from missing real capability-boundary requests or interrupting self-contained native Codex work.
review_instructions: Evaluate every prompt after any change to the SKILL.md description, activation boundary, startup contract, or plugin metadata.
Record the observed activation and startup decision in a pull request, issue, or release note when behavior changes.
Prioritize precision on negative prompts before attempting to widen activation recall.

prompts.label: direct
prompts.prompt: Use SkillScout to start a Figma-to-React project and prepare the GitHub delivery path.
prompts.expected_path: Figma primary; GitHub secondary only when delivery begins.

prompts.label: direct
prompts.prompt: Which Codex capability is the minimum safe path for turning this shared spreadsheet into a weekly report?
prompts.expected_path: Choose the matching spreadsheet or file capability only if a real workbook is available.

prompts.label: direct
prompts.prompt: Do I need a plugin, MCP, or only native Codex to query our internal inventory system?
prompts.expected_path: Explain the MCP boundary and least-privilege access; do not invent availability.

prompts.label: indirect
prompts.prompt: Turn our GitHub issue backlog into a release plan and then open a pull request with the documentation update.
prompts.expected_path: GitHub is the primary capability because the repository is both source and delivery target.

prompts.label: indirect
prompts.prompt: Compare today's public competitor pricing with our uploaded plan and recommend the next move.
prompts.expected_path: Use verified web research for current facts and a file or spreadsheet capability only when the uploaded plan needs inspection.

prompts.label: indirect
prompts.prompt: I have a product idea but no stack or design yet. Help me start the first useful milestone.
prompts.expected_path: Start natively with a brief and avoid recommending a catalog of tools.

prompts.label: negative
prompts.prompt: Explain why this pasted JavaScript function throws an error.
prompts.expected_path: Native Codex analyzes the supplied snippet directly.

prompts.label: negative
prompts.prompt: Rewrite this email to sound warmer and shorter.
prompts.expected_path: Native Codex rewrites the pasted content without Gmail.
